pages.text: Video: Watch Mac Ayres Play A Tiny Desk From Home : NPR Accessibility links Skip to main content Keyboard shortcuts for audio player Video: Watch Mac Ayres Play A Tiny Desk From Home The Long Island R&B singer premieres a new song during his Tiny Desk quarantine concert. Mac Ayres: Tiny Desk (Home) Concert November 30, 2020 5:00 AM ET Bobby Carter Credit: Courtesy of the Artist The Tiny Desk is working from home for the foreseeable future. Introducing NPR Music's Tiny Desk (home) concerts, bringing you performances from across the country and the world. It's the same spirit — stripped-down sets, an intimate setting — just a different space. "Tiny Desk! We finally made it!" exclaimed singer-songwriter Mac Ayres as he finished his opening number, "She Won't Stay Long." I'm sure his fans will especially feel that sentiment since they've made a home in our social media feeds and YouTube comments for years now. We were well on the way to hosting Mac Ayres at our D.C. offices until we had to shut down and pivot. As we worked our way through the adjustment to Tiny Desk (home) concerts, he also needed some time to regroup. Sponsor Message The 23-year-old Long Island native shot this in his basement back in September (hence the 'register to vote' comment). Mac's modus operandi lends itself to the Tiny Desk naturally. No over-produced beats, lots of live instruments and a stunning vocal range — and he handles all duties: guitar, bass, keyboard and background harmonies for three songs from previous albums and the premiere of a new song, "Sometimes." Wow. SET LIST "She Won't Stay Long"

pages.text: Vinicius Jr: Real Madrid forward says transfer interest has affected form - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Vinicius Jr signed a new six-year contract with Real Madrid in August By Marissa Thomas BBC Sport journalist Published 16 November 2026 Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr says he felt "truly overwhelmed" by transfer speculation in the summer, which has contributed to his mixed form at the start of the season. The Brazil international has scored just once and provided three assists in 12 appearances for Jose Mourinho's side this season. He was linked with a move to Premier League champions Arsenal this summer as he entered the final year of his contract, before signing an extension at Real. The 26-year-old also says he did not train as much as he should have following Brazil's last-16 exit at the World Cup. "I don't think I prepared as well as I could have after the World Cup, because the impact of that tournament is so significant for all Brazilians," he said. "Being knocked out so early was something we hadn't expected. So, I took advantage of my holidays to enjoy myself, rest, relax, and spend more time with my family. I ended up training less than in previous years. "That may have affected my start to the season. "On top of that, regarding my contract renewal, with so many clubs showing interest last summer, I felt truly overwhelmed, as with the situation at Real Madrid. But it's a very long season." Most SQLite builds come with a single default VFS that is appropriate for the host computer. New VFSes can be registered and existing VFSes can be unregistered. The following interfaces are provided. The sqlite3_vfs_find() interface returns a pointer to a VFS given its name. Names are case sensitive. Names are zero-terminated UTF-8 strings. If there is no match, a NULL pointer is returned. The same VFS can be registered multiple times without injury. To make an existing VFS into the default VFS, register it again with the makeDflt flag set. May 15, 2024 Español Vision Loss and Diabetes What to know Diabetes can damage your eyes over time and cause vision loss or blindness. Managing your diabetes can help to prevent or delay eye problems. Regular eye exams help to diagnose eye problems early so you can get treatment and protect your eyesight. Diabetic retinopathy Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is the leading cause of blindness in working-age adults. DR is when high blood sugar damages blood vessels in the retina (a part of your eye). Damaged blood vessels can swell and leak, causing blurry vision. DR usually affects both eyes. Diabetes can damage the small blood vessels at the back of the eyes, leading to vision loss. Risk factors Anyone with type 1, type 2, or gestational diabetes (diabetes while pregnant) can develop DR. The longer you have diabetes, the more likely you are to develop it. These factors can also increase your risk: High blood sugar, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels. Smoking. Being an African American, Hispanic/Latino, or American Indian or Alaska Native person. At more than 2,500 feet, the Gocta waterfall, near the village of Cocachimba in northern Peru, is one of the world’s tallest. Ernesto Benavides By Heather Jasper Published October 20, 2026 Although the pre-Incan fortress of Kuélap is almost a thousand years older than Machu Picchu, it gets only a fraction of the crowds. The Chachapoya people built the citadel in northern Peru around the year 500 A.D. on a narrow fin of limestone high above the Utcubamba River—not unlike Machu Picchu’s perch above the Vilcanota River. Visit in 2027 to see new exhibits in the Apu Chuillaxa visitors’ center and walk a new trail in Malcapampa , an active archaeological site that has been newly opened to the public. pages.text: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s single hits piece of broken bat Skip to Content Talk about getting the barrel on it. Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. technically squared up his RBI single in the seventh inning of Friday's 6-5 win over the Reds at Rogers Centre, but he did it in quite an unusual way. On an 0-2 sinker from Cincinnati reliever Luis Mey, Guerrero chopped a ground ball toward the middle, breaking his bat in the process. Then, pure baseball magic took over. Slow-motion replay showed exactly what happened: The severed barrel of Guerrero's bat connected with the baseball several feet in front of home plate, redirecting the ball toward the right side of the infield. It rolled through a hole in the Reds' defense and into right field for a single, scoring Andrés Giménez from second base. Guerrero's hit, which brought in the first run of a pivotal four-run seventh to give Toronto the lead and eventually the win, was far from the first base hit on which a player hit the ball twice. In fact, it was at least the sixth this season -- including two on the same day. While it surely wasn't the hard contact Guerrero envisioned, Friday's double-hit allowed him to "hit 'em where they ain't" in a truly ingenious way.

pages.text: vLLM - PyTorch Search Close Search vLLM vLLM is a high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs. vLLM is an open source library for fast, easy-to-use LLM inference and serving. It optimizes hundreds of language models across diverse data-center hardware—NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, Google TPUs, AWS Trainium, Intel CPUs—using innovations such as PagedAttention, chunked prefill, multi-LoRA and automatic prefix caching. It is designed to serve large scale production traffic with OpenAI compatible server and offline batch inference, scalable to multi-node inference. Voices of Experience The Office of Electricity (OE) pioneered the Voices of Experience (Voices) approach more than a decade ago in response to industry feedback. The Voices efforts convene stakeholders to facilitate peer-to-peer sharing, with conversations focused on technologies and emerging issues facing industry. By actively listening to these conversations, OE gains a greater understanding of how technologies and concepts are being implemented and deployed, helping to identify gaps or barriers that can hinder progress. A Unique Approach The Voices of Experience approach is unique from other DOE stakeholder engagement efforts.
